Title: uTPro Search Plus
Description: Enhance Umbraco site search with synonym expansion and diacritics-insensitive matching, managed from the backoffice. Users searching 'laptop' will also find content containing 'may tinh', 'pc', or 'computer'. Users searching without accents ('cong ty') will find 'cong ty'. Includes a backoffice UI under Settings for creating, editing and testing synonym groups. 25 common Vietnamese-English synonym groups are pre-loaded. Stores data in the Umbraco database (SQL Server, SQLite, PostgreSQL). Integrates automatically with uTPro.Extension.Search for zero-config query expansion. Also exposes an authenticated REST API for synonym CRUD and expansion testing.
